# delnx

> delnx is a Python package for differential expression (DE) analysis of single-cell and bulk genomics data stored in AnnData. It provides GPU-accelerated (JAX) negative binomial GLMs with glmGamPoi-style quasi-likelihood dispersion shrinkage for pseudobulk counts, linear-model and binomial tests for log-normalized or binary data, fast AUROC-based cluster markers, pseudobulking, effect sizes, gene set enrichment, and plots. Install with `pip install delnx`; import as `import delnx as dx`.

Key rules: test condition effects on pseudobulked replicates (`dx.pp.pseudobulk` → `dx.tl.nb_fit` + `dx.tl.nb_test`), not on single cells; NB functions need raw counts (`layer="counts"` if `adata.X` is log-normalized); `dx.tl.de` expects log-normalized data; contrasts use patsy names such as `"treatment[T.drugA]"` (see `fit.design_column_names`).

## Agent skill

- [delnx agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/mlbelab/delnx/blob/main/skills/delnx/SKILL.md): method choice, designs and contrasts, recipes, outputs, common mistakes
- [API reference for agents](https://github.com/mlbelab/delnx/blob/main/skills/delnx/references/api.md): all public signatures and docstrings
- [Tested end-to-end example](https://github.com/mlbelab/delnx/blob/main/skills/delnx/references/example_workflow.py): pseudobulk, NB DE per cell type, markers, volcano plot

## Docs

- [Installation](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html): pip install and optional GPU-enabled JAX
- [API reference](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html): `dx.pp`, `dx.tl`, `dx.pl`, `dx.ds`

## Tutorials

- [Negative binomial DE](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/notebooks/nb.html): `nb_fit` + `nb_test` on pseudobulk counts
- [GLI3 knockout DE](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/notebooks/gli3KO.html): pseudobulking, DE per cell type, plots, enrichment
- [Comparing DE methods](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/notebooks/methods.html): runtime of the DE methods (LR timings predate the `de()` method-routing fix)
- [Benchmark vs glmGamPoi](https://delnx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/notebooks/benchmark.html): concordance with R glmGamPoi and runtime scaling
